meta.name: Discover university programs and faculty sources with Firecrawl and Google Sheets

parameters.content:
## Workflow Overview
This project turns a university homepage, a target field, country, and degree level into a verified degree-program page plus an official faculty / staff directory link.

**Main flow**
1. Capture the homepage URL, target field, country, and degree level from the intake form
2. Normalize the URL and validate all required inputs
3. Scrape the homepage and confirm it's an official, degree-granting university site in the selected country
4. Build targeted queries and search the official domain for the program / department page
5. Rank candidates, scrape the best match, and verify the target field and degree level actually appear on it
6. Search the same official domain for the faculty / staff directory
7. Save the verified (or failed) result to Google Sheets

Regardz:
MUHAMMAD BILAL — AI AUTOMATION SPECIALIST

## 1 — Intake & Website Verification
MUHAMMAD BILAL - AI AUTOMATION SPECIALIST — capture the intake form, normalize the URL, scrape the homepage, and confirm it's an official university site in the right country before continuing.

## 2 — Program & Department Discovery
Build targeted search queries -> search the official domain -> normalize + rank candidates -> route to scraping only if a strong candidate was found.

## 3 — Program & Degree Verification
Scrape the best candidate page -> extract evidence -> verify the target field appears -> verify the degree level appears. Any failed check routes straight to the failure branch.

## 4 — Faculty Source Discovery
Build faculty-focused search queries -> search the same official domain -> score and select the single best faculty / staff directory URL.

## 5 — Verified Result -> Google Sheets
faculty_source_found = true -> assemble the final verified fields -> append the row to Google Sheets.

## Verification Failed -> Fallback Output
Any failed gate (website, field match, degree match, faculty source) lands here -> build a clear failure result -> still logged to the same Google Sheet.
